stem.en: On a map of normal monsoon dates, the line for 1 June crosses Kerala. The last line, 8 July, lies over far western Rajasthan. How many days pass between these two dates? (Answer in days.)

explanation.en: June has 30 days, so 29 days remain after 1 June. Add the 8 days of July: 29 + 8 = 37 days, a little over five weeks. The monsoon needs weeks to spread across India.

hints.en: Count the days left in June after the 1st.
29 days are left in June. Now add the days in July up to the 8th.
